purpose: Teach: 安売り/値動き/外装/試用/贈呈/発案/損得/取り立て

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、創業時、安売りに頼らずブランドを築かれたぞ
lines.en: Your father — he built the brand without relying on discounting when he founded the company.
lines.style: Measured, reverent. Long pause between thoughts, like selecting each memory carefully. Quiet authority in the voice — this is lived knowledge. Slight warmth underneath the formality.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは株式の値動きを毎日見られた
lines.en: Yes. My father watched the stock price every single day.
lines.style: Steady, almost meditative agreement. Not boastful — stating fact with quiet pride. Breath even and controlled. The tone of someone honoring a pattern they understood.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、商品の外装にこだわられたぞ
lines.en: Your father — he paid attention to every detail of the product packaging.
lines.style: Soft, nostalgic. Slight lift in the voice on 'packaging' like he's seeing it in his mind. Unhurried pace. The tenderness of remembering someone's care.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは新商品の試用販売を始められた
lines.en: Yes. My father started trial sales of new products to test the market.
lines.style: Thoughtful acceptance. Warm but formal. Slight nod in the voice — not just confirming, but recognizing the pattern. Deliberate pacing.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、お得意様への贈呈品を自ら選ばれたぞ
lines.en: Your father — he chose the gifts for our valued customers with his own hands.
lines.style: Quiet wonder beneath the words. Slower pace. Small exhale before the final thought, like he's still moved by that attention to detail.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは社員発案の新事業を採用された
lines.en: Yes. My father adopted new business proposals from the staff.
lines.style: Clear and present. Warmth underneath — he's remembering openness, not rigidity. Even breath. The pride of continuing a legacy of trust.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、損得抜きの判断もされたぞ
lines.en: Your father — he made decisions based on principle, not profit.
lines.style: Deep, almost solemn. The slowest line so far. Weight on 'principle.' Trailing into silence like the full meaning is understood without being spelled out.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは厳しい取り立てを社員に強いられなかった
lines.en: Yes. My father never demanded harsh collections from his staff.
lines.style: Final, certain. Quiet strength. Voice settles lower — this is the closing thought, the truest one. No doubt. Breath at the end like a small seal on a promise kept.
